title: Leander, the troll chronicler
summary: The first name in troll history.

claims.text: Troll history begins with Leander, as central to trolls as Homer to the Greeks: a stout, scarred graybeard who was not a troll, of whom no one recalls a youth or a death; the oldest copies of Leander's song date to the late Bronze Age.
A rare few trolls claim clear memories of Leander, and sightings of Leander are a favorite troll tale.
